actions.body:
Dear Selin Brook,

Thank you for your message about invoice INV-012 for shipment VEL-012-26. We can't change the charge based on actual weight alone. Here is why.

The tariff agreed at booking, DW12, bills each carton at whichever is greater: its actual weight or its dimensional weight. Dimensional weight is length x width x height in cm, divided by 5,000, rounded up to a whole kg. Our records show both cartons (C12-A and C12-B) at 50 x 40 x 30 cm and 5 kg each:
- Dimensional weight per carton: 50 x 40 x 30 / 5,000 = 12 kg, which is more than the 5 kg actual weight
- Billable weight: 12 kg + 12 kg = 24 kg
- Charge: 24 kg x GBP 2/kg = GBP 48

So the GBP 48 on INV-012 follows the agreed tariff, and no adjustment has been authorised.

If you believe the recorded carton measurements are wrong, please reply with the dimensions you have for each carton. We can then ask our billing team to review the measurements. Please note that a review is a request to look again, not a guarantee that the charge will change.

Kind regards,
Rivet Delivery Desk

Checked INV-012 against DW12: 2 cartons, 12 dim kg each (actual 5 kg each), 24 kg x GBP 2 = GBP 48, which matches the invoice. Declined the actual-weight re-bill. No credit authorised (E05). Offered a billing measurement review if the customer supplies disputed dimensions.
